change the deployment chart.

### Why this chart had to be forked

The upstream chart's Service template (`templates/service.yaml`) only sets the two
`external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/*` annotations needed for DNS registration, with no way to add
any other annotation through `values.yaml`. On the AWS EKS clusters this connector deploys to, the
AWS Load Balancer Controller reads a dedicated annotation
(`service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: internet-facing`) to decide whether the NLB
it provisions for a `type: LoadBalancer` Service is public or VPC-internal; without it, the
controller defaults to an **internal** NLB, so `tls-participant` (the Tier2 Gateway's public
hostname) would not be reachable from outside the VPC — breaking the participant-to-participant
dataspace protocol, which is the entire purpose of this component.

Tested first against the unmodified public chart: the Service is created, but the resulting AWS NLB
is internal and the external hostname never becomes reachable from outside the cluster's VPC.

### The fix

`templates/service.yaml` gained a standard Helm passthrough block:

```yaml
    {{- with .Values.service.annotations }}
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}
```

This alone does not hardcode any cloud-specific annotation in the chart — it only makes the
Service's annotations configurable. The actual annotation is supplied from the connector's own
values, conditionally on a `lbNetwork` setting (`Agents/connector/charts/templates/application.yaml`,
block "Tier 2 Gateway"):

```yaml
{{- if eq .Values.lbNetwork "cloud" }}
service:
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: internet-facing
{{- end }}
```

`Chart.yaml` and `values.yaml` also differ from upstream, but only because the upstream repository
uses CI placeholders (`${PROJECT_RELEASE_VERSION}`, `${CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE}`) that its own pipeline
substitutes at release time; this fork pins them to the literal baseline version/image so the chart
is usable standalone. No functional change is involved in that part of the diff. `Chart.yaml` also
lost its original inline comments (not a functional change).

No copyright, licence or disclaimer notice of the original work has been altered. No file was
added or removed, only `templates/service.yaml`, `Chart.yaml` and `values.yaml` were modified.
